rate_utd_dtap.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP) vaccination
rate_utd_dtap.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students who are up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP) vaccination.
rate_utd_dtap.long_description: Share of assessed school students reported as up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP) vaccination in the state's annual kindergarten immunization survey. Up to date is defined by the source as 4 or 5 doses administered according to recommended age and intervals.
rate_utd_dtap.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for DTaP vaccination.

rate_utd_polio.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for polio (IPV/OPV) vaccination
rate_utd_polio.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students who are up to date for polio (IPV/OPV) vaccination.
rate_utd_polio.long_description: Share of assessed school students reported as up to date for polio (IPV/OPV) vaccination in the state's annual kindergarten immunization survey. Up to date is defined by the source as 3 or 4 doses administered according to recommended age and intervals.
rate_utd_polio.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for polio vaccination.

rate_utd_mmr.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination
rate_utd_mmr.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students who are up to date for measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination.
rate_utd_mmr.long_description: Share of assessed school students reported as up to date for measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination in the state's annual kindergarten immunization survey. Up to date is defined by the source as 2 or more doses administered according to recommended age and intervals.
rate_utd_mmr.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for MMR vaccination.

rate_utd_hep_b.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for hepatitis B vaccination
rate_utd_hep_b.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students who are up to date for hepatitis B vaccination.
rate_utd_hep_b.long_description: Share of assessed school students reported as up to date for hepatitis B vaccination in the state's annual kindergarten immunization survey. Up to date is defined by the source as 3 or more doses administered according to recommended age and intervals.
rate_utd_hep_b.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for hepatitis B vaccination.

rate_utd_hep_a.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for hepatitis A vaccination
rate_utd_hep_a.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students who are up to date for hepatitis A vaccination.
rate_utd_hep_a.long_description: Share of assessed school students reported as up to date for hepatitis A vaccination in the state's annual kindergarten immunization survey. Up to date is defined by the source as 2 or more doses administered according to recommended age and intervals.
rate_utd_hep_a.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for hepatitis A vaccination.

rate_utd_varicella.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for varicella (chickenpox) vaccination
rate_utd_varicella.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students who are up to date for varicella (chickenpox) vaccination.
rate_utd_varicella.long_description: Share of assessed school students reported as up to date for varicella (chickenpox) vaccination in the state's annual kindergarten immunization survey. Up to date is defined by the source as 1 or more doses administered according to recommended age and intervals.
rate_utd_varicella.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for varicella vaccination.

rate_utd_all.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for all required vaccines
rate_utd_all.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students who are up to date for every required antigen (DTaP, polio, MMR, hepatitis B, hepatitis A, and varicella).
rate_utd_all.long_description: Share of assessed school students reported as up to date for all required vaccines at once, as defined by the source: 4 or 5 doses of DTaP, 3 or 4 doses of polio, 2 or more doses of MMR, 3 or more doses of hepatitis B, 2 or more doses of hepatitis A, and 1 or more doses of varicella, each administered according to recommended age and intervals.
rate_utd_all.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for all required vaccines.

rate_medical.long_name: Proportion of students with a medical vaccination exemption
rate_medical.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_medical.long_description: Share of assessed school students with documentation on file for a medical exemption to one or more required vaccines, as reported in the state's annual kindergarten immunization survey.
rate_medical.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

rate_non_medical.long_name: Proportion of students with a non-medical vaccination exemption
rate_non_medical.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a non-medical (religious or personal-belief) exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_non_medical.long_description: Share of assessed school students with documentation on file for a non-medical exemption to one or more required vaccines, as reported in the state's annual kindergarten immunization survey. The source's Non-Medical category combines religious and personal-belief exemptions.
rate_non_medical.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a non-medical vaccination exemption.

rate_total.long_name: Proportion of students with any vaccination exemption
rate_total.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with any exemption (medical or non-medical) from one or more required vaccines.
rate_total.long_description: Share of assessed school students with documentation on file for any vaccine exemption (medical or non-medical) to one or more required vaccines, as published directly by the source alongside the medical and non-medical breakdown.
rate_total.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a vaccination exemption of any kind.

ok_school_immunization.name: Oklahoma School Immunization Data
ok_school_immunization.description: County-level school immunization and exemption data from the annual OSDH reports and county map.
ok_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.
